notes.title: Untitled
notes.content:
[h1]V118[/h1]

[list]
[*] Avoid routing through stations by making it more expensive to traverse a station for the path-planner.
[*] Faster path planning: (Removed an O(N) rails lookup from the path-planner.)
[*] Better track high-score reports.
[*] Accommodate high tree counts on the Jumbo sized planet.
[/list]

notes.title: V117: More Bug Fixes.
notes.content:
[h1]V117[/h1]

[b]Version 1.17 brings a lot of fixes to Hexa Trains.[/b]
[list]
[*] Do not clear tile with a station/depot on it.
[*] Fix newsticker bug that would scramble PROD/SERVICE stat rendering.
[*] Fix GL_INVALID_INDEX crash that occurred on some Intel HD drivers.
[*] Fix OpenAL out of bounds value for GAIN_MAX.
[*] Remove unused shaders.
[*] Add command line options w=? h=? fs=?
[/list]

notes.title: V116: Bug Fixes.
notes.content:
[h1]V116[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed crash when adding 40th train.
[*] Increased max number of trains from 40 to 80.
[*] Fix bug where two trains merge into one when leaving at the same time.
[/list]

notes.title: V115: Large Text Option, Linux Launch Fix.
notes.content:
[h1]FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Add launch option for large text. Right click on game in Library, Select "Play With Large Text."
[*] Fix Linux Launch issue with libsteam_api.so not being found.
[/list]
[h1]KNOWN ISSUES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Editing route of train in lunar transit can cause crash.
[*] Issues with older libc versions: `GLIBC_2.27' not found
[/list]

notes.title: V114: Fix Crash, Unfreeze Idle Shuttle.
notes.content:
[h1]FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Don't crash when deleting a rail section that is in use by a train.
[*] Fix idle shuttle when space port is overwhelmed with food.
[/list]

[h1]KNOWN BUGS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Editing route of train in lunar transit can cause crash.
[*] Issues with older libc versions: [b]`GLIBC_2.27' not found[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: V113: Fall back to non-MSAA.
notes.content:
Fix: if the window creation fails, we try a fallback without MSAA.

You may need to restart your steam client before it sees the V113 update.

notes.title: V112: Fix excessive logging.
notes.content:
On some machines, the game would create excessively large log files.

V112 fixes this issue.

My apologies for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Hexa Trains Has Launched!
notes.content:
Just moments ago I pressed PUBLISH on the Hexa Trains project.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2B1wMsU.gif[/img]

That means that now, everybody (on  linux or windows, 64b) gets to play this:

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/770603710820356594/E05B3A35B00F85F93DCDCB99F3F7538DC8ACCE0B/[/img]

If you don't wait too long, you can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1133450/Hexa_Trains/]get it[/url] at -40%. Go tell your friends!

And thank you for your support.

I will be at the Steam [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1133450/discussions/]Forums[/url] to answer all your questions.
